##### Project general facts

Altissima by Al Barari is an extraordinary collection of exclusive seven-bedroom villas, conceived as a celebration of architectural excellence, privacy, and timeless luxury. Set within the lush landscapes of Al Barari, the development offers a unique residential sanctuary where nature and contemporary design exist in perfect harmony. Inspired by the symbolism of the Tree of Life, Altissima is envisioned as more than a collection of homes—it is a place of growth, connection, and enduring beauty, created for those who seek an exceptional way of living.

The lifestyle at Altissima is defined by serenity, exclusivity, and an intimate relationship with its natural surroundings. Every villa is thoughtfully positioned within a verdant environment that enhances the sense of peace and seclusion, while the masterfully planned community provides an atmosphere where wellness, elegance, and outdoor living become part of everyday life. Designed for a discerning few, Altissima offers a refined retreat where luxury is expressed through space, privacy, and an effortless connection to nature.

Inside, each villa showcases expansive interiors finished to the highest standards with premium materials and impeccable craftsmanship. Elegant living spaces are designed to balance grandeur with warmth, creating homes that feel both impressive and inviting. Equipped kitchens complement the sophisticated interiors, while the overall design emphasizes light, openness, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Every residence is delivered unfurnished, providing homeowners with the opportunity to create a truly bespoke living environment that reflects their own vision of luxury.

##### Location description and benefits

Discover a sanctuary of luxury and tranquility at Al Barari, a prestigious community nestled in the heart of Dubai. Spanning over 18.42 million square feet, Al Barari offers a harmonious blend of lush green landscapes, stunning architecture, and world-class amenities. This exclusive development is renowned for its commitment to sustainability, featuring themed gardens, serene waterways, and a rich biodiversity that sets it apart as an oasis in the desert.

Home to meticulously designed villas and residences, Al Barari provides an unparalleled living experience for those who seek opulence, privacy, and a connection with nature. Each residence is crafted with precision, featuring high-quality finishes, spacious interiors, and panoramic views of the surrounding greenery.

Residents of Al Barari enjoy access to a range of exceptional amenities, including gourmet dining options, a wellness club, fitness facilities, and a renowned spa. The community's commitment to a sustainable lifestyle is evident in its eco-friendly initiatives, making Al Barari a haven for those who appreciate luxury living in harmony with nature.
